Joint venture to produce HALEU in South Africa
articles.원문 요약: A joint venture between ASP Isotopes Inc subsidiary Quantum Leap Energy and South African state-owned nuclear energy corporation Necsa will develop, finance, build and operate a test bench and commercial-scale facility for the production of high-assay low-enriched uranium at Necsa's Pelindaba site.

articles.원문 요약: US utility American Electric Power and X-energy have signed a joint development agreement to evaluate a potential 960 MW project at a former coal plant site in Sullivan County, Indiana.

articles.제목: Rosatom signs floating nuclear power deal for Indonesia
articles.원문 요약: Electricity generated by floating nuclear power plants will be provided to an East Indonesian island, according to an agreement signed by Rosatom and Indonesian company PT Pembangkit Listrik Nuklir.
